name: fmp_levered_dcf
description:
Levered discounted cash flow valuation for one stock from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): DCF value per share using levered free cash flow, next to the stock price.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/levered-dcf as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, sent as given, e.g. AAPL).
For FMP's standard DCF use fmp_dcf_valuation; for your own inputs calc_dcf_model.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
